notes: City of Hebron, FY ended 9/30/2022, accrual statements (GAAP). Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (Exhibit E, p6; fund columns p5). Taxes 867,463 split by the fund schedules' printed tax lines (General property 327,556 + motor vehicle 36,130 p12; Street sales 59,617 p15; Recreation sales 114,106 p21; Economic Development sales 60,000 p26; Sales Tax 178,086 p27; Debt Service property 91,968 p33), ties exactly. Intergovernmental 409,124: homestead 18,695, pro-rate 827 (p12) and MV fee payments 16,740 (p15) split out; remainder 372,862 state aid. Statement Debt service 18,365 split into Debt Service Fund principal 10,000 / interest 8,365 (p33). Other financing (p6): long-term debt proceeds printed 0 (debt_proceeds null); principal (43,734) and interest (29,530) -> other_financing. Roll-forward: 773,902 + 2,194,338 - 2,008,170 + 605,407 - 605,407 - 73,264 = 886,806. Cash: governmental funds balance sheet p4 (cash in bank, cash on hand, county treasurer, restricted cash) with CDs in the investment fields; beginning from the 2021 comparative column. Business-type: Electric, Water, Sewage Disposal (p9 columns, p10 totals); receipts = operating 2,046,967 + interest revenue 9,446; disbursements = operating expenses 1,800,518 + loss on disposition 39,883 + interest expense 9,344; 6,432,943 + 2,056,413 - 1,849,745 = 6,639,611. The Statement of Activities (p2) omits the loss row (report discrepancy). Business 'Miscellaneous' 8,449 counted in charges for services because the Statement of Activities charges for services (2,046,967) equals total operating revenues. Balance sheet from Exhibit A (p1); due to/from other funds 731,550 not eliminated in the Totals column. Detail: General revenue Sched 2 (p12), General expenditures from the more detailed Sched 2A (p13) (Sched 2 object summary not recorded); Street revenue Sched 4 (p15), expenditures Sched 4A (p16); nonmajor fund schedules 9-20, 22, 24 (schedules tie to the p5 Non-Major column: revenues 910,450); Electric/Water/Sewer from Sched 29 budgetary-basis totals (p35), the only schedule for them. Sched 28/29 governmental lines not recorded (duplicate the fund schedules). Park/Cemetery/Library Sinking schedules have only zero actuals (capital outlay budget lines recorded). Grant lines with no grantor printed (Library 'Grants', Grant Project 'Grant income') are category other / Grants (user ruling 2026-11-12). Transfers: in 605,407 = General 64,921 + nonmajor 540,486; out = General 307,121 + Sales Tax 64,921 + Fire Truck Sinking 233,365; all balance. Trim holds report pp4-7, 9-10, 12-16, 36-41, 47-61, 63, 68-69 (schedules 1, 6-8, 23, 25-27 not in the trim). Read pages 1-35 of 35
